SELECT c.category_id, c.name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue
FROM payment p
JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT to_char(month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_utc, cnt AS rentals
FROM (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', rental_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM rental
  GROUP BY month
) t
ORDER BY rentals DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS films_longer_than_avg
FROM film
WHERE length IS NOT NULL
  AND length > (SELECT AVG(length) FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL);

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (payment_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))::int AS year,
       SUM(amount)::numeric(12,2) AS total_amount
FROM payment
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT c.name, COUNT(fc.film_id) AS film_count
  FROM category c
  LEFT JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id
  GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
)
SELECT name, film_count
FROM counts
WHERE film_count = (SELECT MIN(film_count) FROM counts);

SELECT ROUND(
   100.0 * (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL AND (r.return_date - r.rental_date) > (f.rental_duration * INTERVAL '1 day')))::numeric
   / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL),0)::numeric
,2) AS percent_late
FROM rental r
JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id;

SELECT c.name AS category, SUM(p.amount)::numeric(12,2) AS total_revenue
FROM payment p
JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT to_char(rental_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM') AS month_utc,
       count(*) AS rentals
FROM rental
GROUP BY month_utc
ORDER BY rentals DESC, month_utc
LIMIT 1;

       SUM(amount)::numeric(14,2) AS total_payment
FROM payment
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM payment_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
ORDER BY year;

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT c.category_id, c.name, COUNT(fc.film_id) AS film_count
  FROM category c
  LEFT JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id
  GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
)
SELECT name, film_count
FROM counts
WHERE film_count = (SELECT MIN(film_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY name;

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(
  (SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date IS NOT NULL
             AND r.return_date > r.rental_date + (f.rental_duration * INTERVAL '1 day')
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric * 100)
  /
  NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)
, 2), 0.00) AS pct_late
FROM rental r
JOIN inventory i USING (inventory_id)
JOIN film f USING (film_id);

  ) AS month_start

  SELECT date_trunc('month', rental_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS month_start, count(*) AS cnt
  FROM rental
  GROUP BY 1
),
joined AS (
  SELECT m.month_start,
         coalesce(c.cnt, 0) AS cnt
  FROM months m
  LEFT JOIN cnts c ON m.month_start = c.month_start
),

  SELECT to_char(month_start,'YYYY-MM') AS month,
         cnt,
         lag(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_cnt,
         cnt - lag(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS increase
  FROM joined
)

CASE WHEN total_count = 0 THEN 0
ELSE ROUND(100.0 * late_count / total_count, 2) END AS percent_late
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ( ( ( ( ( ( ( ( ( (
        -- return date Julian day number (integer part)
        (CAST(substr(return_date,9,2) AS INTEGER)
         + CAST( ( (153 * (CAST(substr(return_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) + 12 * CAST((14 - CAST(substr(return_date,6,2) AS INTEGER))/12 AS INTEGER) - 3) + 2) / 5) AS INTEGER)
         + 365 * (CAST(substr(return_date,1,4) AS INTEGER) + 4800 - CAST((14 - CAST(substr(return_date,6,2) AS INTEGER))/12 AS INTEGER))
         + CAST((CAST(substr(return_date,1,4) AS INTEGER) + 4800 - CAST((14 - CAST(substr(return_date,6,2) AS INTEGER))/12 AS INTEGER))/4 AS INTEGER)
         - CAST((CAST(substr(return_date,1,4) AS INTEGER) + 4800 - CAST((14 - CAST(substr(return_date,6,2) AS INTEGER))/12 AS INTEGER))/100 AS INTEGER)
         + CAST((CAST(substr(return_date,1,4) AS INTEGER) + 4800 - CAST((14 - CAST(substr(return_date,6,2) AS INTEGER))/12 AS INTEGER))/400 AS INTEGER)
         - 32045)
       )
      + (CAST(substr(return_date,12,2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + CAST(substr(return_date,15,2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(substr(return_date,18,2) AS INTEGER)) / 86400.0
    )
    - ( ( ( ( ( ( ( ( ( (
        -- rental date Julian day number (integer part)
        (CAST(substr(rental_date,9,2) AS INTEGER)
         + CAST( ( (153 * (CAST(substr(rental_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) + 12 * CAST((14 - CAST(substr(rental_date,6,2) AS INTEGER))/12 AS INTEGER) - 3) + 2) / 5) AS INTEGER)
         + 365 * (CAST(substr(rental_date,1,4) AS INTEGER) + 4800 - CAST((14 - CAST(substr(rental_date,6,2) AS INTEGER))/12 AS INTEGER))
         + CAST((CAST(substr(rental_date,1,4) AS INTEGER) + 4800 - CAST((14 - CAST(substr(rental_date,6,2) AS INTEGER))/12 AS INTEGER))/4 AS INTEGER)
         - CAST((CAST(substr(rental_date,1,4) AS INTEGER) + 4800 - CAST((14 - CAST(substr(rental_date,6,2) AS INTEGER))/12 AS INTEGER))/100 AS INTEGER)
         + CAST((CAST(substr(rental_date,1,4) AS INTEGER) + 4800 - CAST((14 - CAST(substr(rental_date,6,2) AS INTEGER))/12 AS INTEGER))/400 AS INTEGER)
         - 32045)
       )
      + (CAST(substr(rental_date,12,2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + CAST(substr(rental_date,15,2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(substr(rental_date,18,2) AS INTEGER)) / 86400.0
    )
    ) > rental.rental_duration THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_count
  FROM rental
  JOIN inventory USING(inventory_id)
  JOIN film ON film.film_id = inventory.film_id

WITH r AS (
  SELECT r.rental_id, r.rental_date, r.return_date, f.rental_duration,
    CAST(substr(return_date,1,4) AS INTEGER) AS ry,
    CAST(substr(return_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) AS rm,
    CAST(substr(return_date,9,2) AS INTEGER) AS rd,
    CAST(substr(return_date,12,2) AS INTEGER) AS rh,
    CAST(substr(return_date,15,2) AS INTEGER) AS rmin,
    CAST(substr(return_date,18,2) AS INTEGER) AS rs,
    CAST(substr(rental_date,1,4) AS INTEGER) AS sy,
    CAST(substr(rental_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) AS sm,
    CAST(substr(rental_date,9,2) AS INTEGER) AS sd,
    CAST(substr(rental_date,12,2) AS INTEGER) AS sh,
    CAST(substr(rental_date,15,2) AS INTEGER) AS smin,
    CAST(substr(rental_date,18,2) AS INTEGER) AS ss
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i USING(inventory_id)
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL
),
calc AS (
  SELECT *,
    (
      rd
      + CAST((153 * (rm + 12 * CAST((14 - rm)/12 AS INTEGER) - 3) + 2) / 5 AS INTEGER)
      + 365 * (ry + 4800 - CAST((14 - rm)/12 AS INTEGER))
      + CAST((ry + 4800 - CAST((14 - rm)/12 AS INTEGER))/4 AS INTEGER)
      - CAST((ry + 4800 - CAST((14 - rm)/12 AS INTEGER))/100 AS INTEGER)
      + CAST((ry + 4800 - CAST((14 - rm)/12 AS INTEGER))/400 AS INTEGER)
      - 32045
    ) + (rh * 3600 + rmin * 60 + rs) / 86400.0 AS jd_return,
    (
      sd
      + CAST((153 * (sm + 12 * CAST((14 - sm)/12 AS INTEGER) - 3) + 2) / 5 AS INTEGER)
      + 365 * (sy + 4800 - CAST((14 - sm)/12 AS INTEGER))
      + CAST((sy + 4800 - CAST((14 - sm)/12 AS INTEGER))/4 AS INTEGER)
      - CAST((sy + 4800 - CAST((14 - sm)/12 AS INTEGER))/100 AS INTEGER)
      + CAST((sy + 4800 - CAST((14 - sm)/12 AS INTEGER))/400 AS INTEGER)
      - 32045
    ) + (sh * 3600 + smin * 60 + ss) / 86400.0 AS jd_rental
  FROM r
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
  ELSE ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN (jd_return - jd_rental) > rental_duration THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2)
  END AS percent_late
FROM calc;

SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(*) AS film_count

ORDER BY film_count DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS action_films
FROM film f

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_cities

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS num_customers_rented FROM rental;

WITH film_rentals AS (

         COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rentals
  FROM film f
  JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title, f.rating
)
SELECT rating, title, rentals
FROM (
  SELECT *,

  FROM film_rentals
) t
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY rating;

SELECT

FROM rental r
JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id;

WITH total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category_id) AS cnt FROM film_category
), cust_cat AS (
  SELECT r.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT fc.category_id) AS cnt
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id
  GROUP BY r.customer_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_all_categories
FROM cust_cat, total
WHERE cust_cat.cnt = total.cnt;

SELECT ctry.country AS country, COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM customer cust
JOIN address addr ON cust.address_id = addr.address_id
JOIN city ci ON addr.city_id = ci.city_id
JOIN country ctry ON ci.country_id = ctry.country_id
GROUP BY ctry.country
ORDER BY num_customers DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_first_rental_2023
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(rental_date) AS first_rental
  FROM rental
  GROUP BY customer_id
) t
WHERE first_rental >= '2023-01-01'
  AND first_rental < '2024-01-01';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (rental_date - prev_date))/86400.0)::numeric,2) AS avg_days
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, rental_date,
         LAG(rental_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY rental_date) AS prev_date
  FROM rental
) t
WHERE prev_date IS NOT NULL;

SELECT c.name AS category_name,
       ROUND(AVG(f.rental_rate)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rental_rate,
       COUNT(*) AS film_count
FROM film f
JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY AVG(f.rental_rate) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', rental_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS month_start,
         to_char(date_trunc('month', rental_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
         count(*) AS cnt
  FROM rental
  GROUP BY month_start
),
diff AS (
  SELECT month, month_start, cnt, cnt - lag(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS increase
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month, increase
FROM diff
WHERE increase IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY increase DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(length)::numeric, 2) AS avg_length_minutes

SELECT COUNT(*) AS not_returned_count FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NULL;

SELECT f.title, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rentals

SELECT c.category_id, c.name AS category, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue

JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id

SELECT to_char((rental_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), 'YYYY-MM') AS month_utc,

         rental_date,
         LAG(rental_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY rental_date) AS prev_rental

    count(*) AS rentals
  FROM rental

), diffs AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    rentals,
    rentals - LAG(rentals) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change_from_prev
  FROM monthly
)

FROM diffs

ORDER BY increase DESC
LIMIT 1;
